trace.notes: The zbMATH record identified the exact work, title, and DOI 10.1016/j.ins.2015.08.029, but zbMATH itself was used only as a bibliographic resolver.

Crossref and OpenAlex matched the same exact work. The recovered repository landing page at https://ricerca.uniparthenope.it/handle/11367/48061 is metadata-only and explicitly reports that no files are attached, while the publisher API reports openaccessArticle=false. No readable exact-work PDF or full-text HTML artifact was recovered, so extraction from abstracts/metadata was rejected.
